'''September 2004 Fort Worth tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Sunday 26 September 2004 at noon at Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3970-54215">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54215#54215 texas tournament on 09/26/2004], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 September 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041211034803/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54215%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed Swiss tournament with an unlimited card pool, of two or three rounds and no final confrontation, with a $5 entry fee; four uncut sheets were announced as prizes.<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Y2Komics, 5270 Trail Lake Drive, Fort Worth, Texas<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />
* '''Dates:''' 26 September 2004<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool; Swiss, two or three rounds<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-3970-54215" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
